text: Huashu Design 是面向通用 agent runtime 的 HTML 视觉设计 skill，适合制作交互原型、网页界面、幻灯片、动画视频、信息图和小红书图文。它通过 DSH 的 filesystem skill provider 加载仓库中的 SKILL.md，再按任务路由到专门手册；工作流包含方向探索、品牌与素材研究、设计检查和交付导出。辅助脚本可检查页面可读性、导出 PDF 或可编辑 PPTX，并渲染轮播图。适合需要快速产出可审阅视觉稿的设计师和产品团队；基础流程不要求额外 API 配置，云端视频评审与语音合成属于可选能力。

Huashu Design is an HTML visual design skill for agents. It guides prototypes, websites, slides, motion, infographics, and Xiaohongshu carousels. Scripts inspect layouts, render previews, and export vector PDFs or editable PPTX. Cloud video review and speech synthesis are optional.

Huashu Design 的功能「方向探索流程」：新视觉任务先比较多个真实设计方向，提供初稿供用户选择后再进入完整制作。
Huashu Design 的功能「网页与交互原型」：按网页模块制作 HTML 界面，并在交付前检查响应式视口、交互和可读性。
Huashu Design 的功能「幻灯片 PDF 导出」：多文件 HTML deck 可按文件名排序渲染并合并为矢量 PDF，保留可搜索文字。
Huashu Design 的功能「可编辑 PPTX 导出」：符合约束的 HTML 幻灯片可转换为原生 PowerPoint 对象；不符合时报告转换失败。
Huashu Design 的功能「小红书轮播渲染与检查」：按页面或长卷输出轮播图片和总览图，同时检测字号、越界文字、跨页断字与文字重叠。
Huashu Design 的功能「设计页面体检」：检查页面字号、对比度、模板装饰和布局特征，并提供方向对比及本地外观账本。
Huashu Design 的功能「素材与能力探测」：识别本机设计 skill、环境 key 是否存在及 Node、ffmpeg、npx 等工具，为流程选择素材档位。
Huashu Design 的功能「语音合成及视频评审」：可选脚本将文本发送至豆包 TTS，或将动画片段发送至火山方舟视频评审并生成报告。
Huashu Design 使用前须知：云端视频评审为可选路径，会把压缩后的视频片段发送到火山方舟接口；调用需要 ARK_API_KEY 与明确确认。（见 scripts/cloud/ai-review-video.py:5-17）
Huashu Design 使用前须知：语音合成会把待配音文本发送至字节跳动 TTS 接口，需要配置音色；这是可选流程。（见 scripts/cloud/tts-doubao.mjs:1-35）

huashu-design README · DeepSeek Harness 插件：本仓库同时是一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）插件。桌面端用户在「插件 → 添加插件」里填 GitHub 仓库地址，或者用命令行（桌面端的 profile 叫 `desktop`，网页版换成 `web`）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:alchaincyf/huashu-design
```

命令行装之前，桌面端要先打开过一次，并且完全退出。装完再打开 DSH，插件才会加载。实测桌面端会直接用它自带的 Python 生成可编辑 PPTX；要导出 PDF 时，脚本会借用你电脑上已装的 Chrome 或 Edge。卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove huashu-design`。

| 3 · 下载资产 | SVG 文件 → 官网 HTML 全文 → 产品截图取色 | 三条兜底，前一条失败立刻走下一条 |
| 4 · grep 提取色值 | 从资产里抓所有 `#xxxxxx`，按频率排序，过滤黑白灰 | **绝不从记忆猜品牌色** |
| 5 · 固化 spec | 写 `brand-spec.md` + CSS 变量，所有 HTML 引用 `var(--brand-*)` | 不固化就会忘 |
huashu-design README · 品牌资产协议：A/B 测试（v1 vs v2，各跑 6 agent）：**v2 的稳定性方差比 v1 低 5 倍**。稳定性的稳定性，这是 skill 真正的护城河。

huashu-design README · 设计方向顾问（Fallback）：当用户需求模糊到无法着手时触发（3.0 重做）：

- 先对话澄清 + 主动索要参考（名字 / logo / 品牌色 / 喜欢的参考站），只问一轮
- 取齐内容必需的真图（公共领域 / 免版权，脚本一键抓），再开工
- **三套逻辑各出两个候选，共六个**：① 最佳设计师（两位气质不同的设计师，用他们的思维从头做）② 现实参照（两件**同媒介**的获奖作品——做 App 找 App、做 deck 找出版物；`scripts/ref_board.py` 先截图亲眼看，再拆网格、字号比和色彩比例）③ 秒数轮盘（`date +%S` 取秒，在产出形态对应的分区和中文东亚分区各抽一号，先看样张再动手）
- **六张缩略图 → 挑三版做完整稿**：单看够好、彼此不一样、不撞你最近的项目；没选上的三张作为备选一起给你，看中哪张再做
- **绝不让你在没看到视觉时盲选风格**——摆出来就停，看着选
- 底层是 **92 种 HTML 原生风格库**，每种配一张样张和源码（`assets/style-specimens/`），作弹药，不是教条
huashu-design README · 设计方向顾问（Fallback）：为什么这样做：我们拿固定题目做了三轮改前改后盲选（内部测试）。第一轮强制每版套一个大隐喻，页面被做成道具，4 题只赢 1 题；第二轮为了躲 AI 默认外观加了一堆禁令，三版一起变得「太规整，太无聊」，2 题全输；第三轮改成加选项、不加禁令——多出候选、给看得见的样张、看真参考——同两道题都赢了。

huashu-design README · 越用越懂你：经验、外观账本与设计体检：- **经验**：`scripts/learn.py` 开工前带出你说过的品味原话（「太素了」「A 的结构加 C 的颜色」）和过去的教训，收工时把值得记的记下来；记录前会告诉你，不想记可以拒绝
- **外观账本**：每次交付记一笔「长什么样」（底色、色板、字体、版式骨架，连同项目名和所在路径），下个项目主动避开——单个项目看都不错、放在一起却长得像，这种单调靠它管
- **设计体检**：`scripts/design_lint.py` 只量能核对的事实——图裂了、字小到读不了、对比度不够、控制台报错是红灯；全大写小标签、「A · B · C」这类顺手的模板装饰是黄灯；三版是不是换皮、和最近的项目撞没撞，`compare` 和 `ledger check` 来查。好不好看归你判断，它不打分
- 这些记录只存在你本机的 `~/.huashu-design/`，不随 skill 分发，删掉文件夹就全部忘记

huashu-design README · 反 AI slop 规则：避免一眼 AI 的视觉最大公约数：紫渐变、emoji 图标、圆角+左 border accent、SVG 画人脸、Inter 做 display，以及 2026 年的新一代模板装饰（每个标题上一行全大写小标签、「A · B · C」中点连接、按钮尾巴的「→」、标题只给一个词换色）。不编造数据、评价和 logo 墙。

暖纸衬线、深底单点缀这类「外观家族」不在禁令里：盲选里被用户认可的几版，恰好就有这两类。真正要避免的是三版挤在同一个家族、每个项目都长一个样——那交给外观账本。

huashu-design README · Core Asset Protocol · 5-step hard process：Mandatory whenever the task involves a specific brand: ask → search → download (three fallback paths) → verify + extract → write `brand-spec.md` covering **logo, product shots, UI screenshots, colors, fonts** — all required assets, not just colors.

---
huashu-design README · Core Asset Protocol：The hardest rule in the skill. When the task touches a specific brand (Stripe, Linear, Anthropic, DJI, your own company, etc.), five steps are enforced:

huashu-design README · Core Asset Protocol：| Step | Action | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| 1 · Ask | Checklist of 6 asset types: logo / product shots / UI screenshots / color palette / fonts / brand guidelines | Respect existing resources |
| 2 · Search official channels | `<brand>.com/brand` · `<brand>.com/press` · `brand.<brand>.com` · product pages · launch films | Find authoritative assets |
| 3 · Download by asset type | Logo (SVG → inline-SVG in HTML → social avatar) · Product shots (hero → press kit → launch video frames → AI-generated from reference) · UI (App Store screenshots → official video frames) | Three fallback paths per asset type |
| 4 · Verify + extract | Check logo fidelity · product image resolution · UI freshness · grep color hex from real assets | **Never guess from memory** |
| 5 · Freeze to spec | Write `brand-spec.md` with logo paths, product image paths, UI screenshot paths, CSS variables for colors/fonts | Un-frozen knowledge evaporates |

huashu-design README · Core Asset Protocol：**Ranking of asset importance** (from the skill's internal rubric):

1. Logo — mandatory for any brand
2. Product renders — mandatory for physical products
3. UI screenshots — mandatory for digital products
4. Color values — auxiliary
5. Fonts — auxiliary

A/B-tested (v1 vs v2, 6 agents each): **v2 reduced stability variance by 5×**. Stability of stability — that's the real moat.

huashu-design README · Design Direction Advisor (Fallback)：- One round of questions, asking for references up front (name / logo / brand colors / sites you like)
- Fetch the real images the content needs (public domain / royalty-free) before designing
- **Three logics, two candidates each — six in total**: ① Best designer (two designers of different temperament, thinking from scratch the way they would) ② Real-world reference (two award-winning works **in the same medium** — apps for an app, publications for a deck; `scripts/ref_board.py` screenshots them so the agent actually looks before extracting grid, type ratios and color proportions) ③ Seconds roulette (`date +%S` picks one style from the matching section and one from the Chinese & East Asian section; the agent opens its specimen first)
- **Six thumbnails → three full designs**: strong on its own, different from each other, not a repeat of your recent projects. The other three thumbnails come along as alternates
- **You never pick a style from words alone** — it stops once the designs are on the table
- Backed by a **92-style HTML-native library**, each with a specimen image and source (`assets/style-specimens/`) — ammunitio

huashu-design README · Design Direction Advisor (Fallback)：Why: we ran three rounds of blind before/after tests on fixed briefs (internal). Round one forced a big metaphor onto every direction, turned pages into props, and won 1 of 4; round two piled on bans to dodge the "AI default look", made all three directions "too regular, too boring", and lost both briefs; round three switched to more options instead of more bans — more candidates, visible specimens, real references — and won both.

huashu-design README · Learns as you use it: experience, look ledger, design check：- **Experience**: `scripts/learn.py` recalls your verbatim taste notes ("too plain", "A's layout with C's colors") and past lessons before work starts, and records what's worth keeping afterwards — it tells you when it records, and you can decline
- **Look ledger**: every delivery logs what it looked like (background, palette, fonts, layout skeleton, plus the project name and path), so the next project steers away — the "each one fine, together all the same" kind of monotony
- **Design check**: `scripts/design_lint.py` only measures checkable facts — broken images, unreadably small text, low contrast, console errors are red; habitual template chrome (uppercase eyebrows, "A · B · C" chains) is yellow; `compare` and `ledger check` catch reskins and repeats. Whether it looks good is your call; it gives no score
- All of this lives only on your machine in `~/.huashu-design/`, never ships with the skill; delete the folder to forget everything

huashu-design README · Junior Designer Workflow：The default working mode across every task:

- Send the full question set in one batch, wait for all answers before moving
- Write assumptions + placeholders + reasoning comments directly into the HTML
- Show it to the user early (even if just gray blocks)
- Fill in real content → variations → Tweaks — show at each of these three steps
- Manually eyeball the browser with Playwright before delivery

huashu-design README · Fact Verification First (Principle #0)：The highest-priority rule, added after a real failure mode: when the task mentions a specific product / technology / event (e.g., "DJI Pocket 4", "Nano Banana Pro", "Gemini 3 Pro"), the first action **must** be a `WebSearch` to confirm existence, release status, current version, and specs. No claims from training-corpus memory. Cost of a search: ~10 seconds. Cost of a wrong assumption: 1–2 hours of rework.

huashu-design README · Anti AI-slop Rules：Avoid the visual common denominator of AI output: purple gradients, emoji icons, rounded-corner + left border accent, SVG humans, Inter-as-display, **CSS silhouettes standing in for real product shots**, and the 2026 generation of template chrome (an uppercase eyebrow over every heading, "A · B · C" dot chains, trailing "→", one recolored word per headline). No invented data, testimonials or logo walls.

huashu-design README · Anti AI-slop Rules："Look families" like warm paper + serif or dark + one accent are not banned: the versions users approved in blind tests included both. What to avoid is all three directions crowding into one family, or every project looking the same — that's the look ledger's job.

---

huashu-design README · vs. Claude Design：I'll be upfront: the Core Asset Protocol's philosophy was lifted from system prompts Anthropic wrote for Claude Design. That prompt hammers home a single idea — **great hi-fi design doesn't start from a blank page, it grows from existing design context**. That one principle is the difference between a 65-point design and a 90-point design.

Positioning differences:

huashu-design README · vs. Claude Design：| | Claude Design | huashu-design |
|---|---|---|
| Form | Web product (used in browser) | Skill (used in Claude Code) |
| Quota | Subscription quota | API usage · parallel agents unblocked |
| Output | Canvas + Figma export | HTML / MP4 / GIF / editable PPTX / PDF |
| Interaction | GUI (click, drag, edit) | Conversation (tell agent, wait) |
| Complex animation | Limited | Stage + Sprite timeline · 60fps export |
| Agent compatibility | Claude.ai only | Claude Code / Cursor / Trae / Hermes / OpenClaw |

huashu-design README · vs. Claude Design：Claude Design is a **better graphics tool**. Huashu-design makes **the graphics-tool layer disappear**. Two paths, different audiences.

---

huashu-design README · Security & Data Flow：The core pipeline (design → render → MP4/PDF/PPTX export) runs **100% locally — zero network calls, zero API keys**. Cloud features (Doubao TTS narration, AI video review) are isolated in `scripts/cloud/`, fully optional: your own keys, official vendor APIs only, and an explicit `--yes` consent gate before anything leaves your machine. No telemetry; nothing is ever sent to any author-controlled server. The 3.0 local records (taste experience, look ledger) are written only to `~/.huashu-design/` and never uploaded; the reference board only visits URLs when you have the agent screenshot reference works. Every outbound host, credential touchpoint, and deletion boundary is exhaustively declared in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — point your agent at it and verify against the code.

huashu-design README · Limitations：- **No layer-editable PPTX-to-Figma round-trip.** The output is HTML — screenshottable, recordable, image-exportable, but not draggable into Keynote for text-position tweaks.
- **Framer-Motion-tier complex animations are out of scope.** 3D, physics simulation, particle systems exceed the skill's boundaries.
- **Brand-from-zero design quality drops to 60–65 points.** Drawing hi-fi from nothing was always a last resort.

huashu-design README · Limitations：This is an 80-point skill, not a 100-point product. For people unwilling to open a graphical UI, an 80-point skill beats a 100-point product.

huashu-design README · Origin Story：The day Anthropic launched Claude Design I played with it until 4 a.m. A few days later I realized I hadn't opened it once since — not because it's bad (it's the most polished product in the category) but because I'd rather have an agent work in my terminal than open any graphical UI.

huashu-design README · Origin Story：So I had an agent deconstruct Claude Design itself (including the system prompts circulating in the community, the brand asset protocol, the component mechanics), distill it into a structured spec, then write it as a skill installed in my own Claude Code.

Thanks to Anthropic for writing the Claude Design prompts so clearly. This kind of derivative work inspired by other products is the new form of open-source culture in the AI era.
